# Reproduction package

A GARS run of nf-core/atacseq 2.1.2 (pipeline commit `<PIPELINE_COMMIT>`) at GARS commit `<GARS_COMMIT>`.

Re-run: `bash rerun.sh --out <empty folder>`

Verify: `python3 verify.py` (this package), then `python3 verify.py --against <that folder>` (the re-run's outputs).

Container images are pinned by tag; the run did not record their digests (PROVENANCE.md).
